description: Frontend persistence + continuity + clear UX. Persist the chat transcript in localStorage keyed per monster (ddm.chat.<monsterId>) via guarded helpers mirroring the pet/zukan pattern, restore it on load, forward the recent N turns as ChatRequest.history for continuity, add a 「会話をクリア / Clear conversation」 button in ChatPanel that clears both in-memory and persisted history, and extend reset() to also wipe the persisted key. New i18n strings get ja+en parity. Depends on FEAT-001 (ChatTurn/history type, MAX_CHAT_TURNS, trimChatHistory).
steps: STORAGE CHOICE (document in code comments): use localStorage keyed PER MONSTER (`ddm.chat.<monsterId>`), consistent with the no-auth browser-owned-id design and the existing ddm.* guarded helpers (pet, zukan). This avoids any DynamoDB schema / Monster save-shape / validateMonster change. Record the rationale in a JSDoc comment on the new helper.

In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts add guarded chat-storage helpers mirroring the zukan/pet helpers: `export function chatStorageKey(monsterId: string): string` returning `ddm.chat.${monsterId}`; a PURE `export function parseChatLog(raw: string | null): ChatLine[]` that JSON.parses in try/catch and keeps only well-formed { role:'player'|'monster', text:string } entries (reuse/parallel the trimChatHistory shape; import ChatLine type or define a structural subset) — return [] on null/empty/malformed; `export function serializeChatLog(log): string` (JSON.stringify, after trimming to the shared MAX_CHAT_TURNS so stored size stays bounded); and guarded `readChatLogRaw(monsterId)`, `readChatLog(monsterId)`, `writeChatLog(monsterId, log)`, `clearChatLog(monsterId)` wrappers with the `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` + try/catch guard. Keep ChatLine's optional modelId when persisting monster lines.

In packages/frontend/src/state/useMonster.ts: on mount (inside the load effect, once monsterId is known) initialize chatLog from readChatLog(monsterId) so a reload re-displays the recent transcript. Persist via writeChatLog(current.id, nextLog) whenever chatLog changes meaningfully — simplest correct approach: after appending the player line and after appending the monster reply in sendChat, write the updated log; prefer computing the next array and both setState + writeChatLog from it (avoid relying on stale state).

In sendChat, build the history argument from the CURRENT chatLog (the turns BEFORE the new player message) mapped to ChatTurn ({role, text}) and pass it as `history` on the api.chat({...}) call, letting the shared cap apply. You MAY pre-trim client-side with trimChatHistory/MAX_CHAT_TURNS from @ddm/shared so the client sends at most N (the server still re-validates). Keep lang, monsterId, stageId, monsterName as today.

Add a `clearChat` callback to useMonster that clears the in-memory chatLog (setChatLog([])) AND calls clearChatLog(current.id); expose it on UseMonsterState. Extend the existing reset() so that in addition to setChatLog([]) it also calls clearChatLog(current.id) (persisted history must be wiped on reset per the acceptance criteria). Guard all storage calls (they already never throw).

In packages/frontend/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx add a 「会話をクリア」 button (only when enabled and log.length > 0) wired to a new `onClear` prop. Follow the existing destructive-action convention: either a simple button or, to match reset's two-step pattern, a lightweight confirm — a plain button is acceptable here since clearing chat is less destructive than reset; if adding a confirm, reuse the i18n confirm keys. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (no new motion introduced). Place the button in the chat panel header/near the form, with an aria-label.

In packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts add new keys with BOTH ja + en (JA source of truth, EN typed): `chat.clear` (ja: 会話をクリア / en: Clear conversation) and its aria `chat.clearAria` (ja: 会話をクリア / en: Clear conversation); if you add a confirm step also add `chat.clearConfirmPrompt`/`chat.clearConfirm`/`chat.clearCancel` with ja+en. Do NOT alter any existing key's JA bytes.

Add PURE unit tests to packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts for the new helpers: parseChatLog drops malformed/returns [] on null/malformed JSON and preserves valid lines + modelId; serializeChatLog round-trips and trims to MAX_CHAT_TURNS; chatStorageKey returns the per-monster key. (These are the pure, DOM-free parts — the file is node:test only, no React render.)
VERIFY: run build + both test suites; confirm frontend test count grew and all pass, shared still green, build clean.
acceptance_criteria: Chat transcript persists to localStorage under `ddm.chat.<monsterId>` via guarded helpers, and a page reload re-displays the recent conversation (chatLog initialized from readChatLog on mount).
sendChat forwards the recent turns as ChatRequest.history (client sends at most MAX_CHAT_TURNS), giving the monster continuity; backward compatible (api.chat already forwards the field).
A 「会話をクリア / Clear conversation」 button in ChatPanel clears BOTH the in-memory log and the persisted ddm.chat.<monsterId> key.
reset() also wipes the persisted ddm.chat.<monsterId> key (in addition to clearing the in-memory log).
New i18n keys exist in BOTH ja and en; no existing JA key changed byte-for-byte; no new runtime dependency; prefers-reduced-motion respected.
`npm test -w @ddm/frontend` passes with new pure helper tests (count > 112); `npm run build` passes.
verification: npm test -w @ddm/frontend passes; new chat-storage helper tests present and pass; total > 112
Manual/code-review trace: on mount chatLog = readChatLog(monsterId); sendChat passes history; clearChat + reset both call clearChatLog
findings: Implemented frontend persistence/continuity/clear UX. Added chat-storage helpers to ui-helpers.ts (chatStorageKey, parseChatLog, serializeChatLog, readChatLogRaw/readChatLog/writeChatLog/clearChatLog, StoredChatLine structural type to avoid circular import; serialize trims to MAX_CHAT_TURNS). useMonster.ts: restores chatLog from readChatLog(advanced.id) on mount; sendChat builds history via trimChatHistory(current log) and passes it on api.chat; persists via writeChatLog on player line, monster reply, and error reply (explicit next arrays, no stale state); added clearChat callback (setChatLog([]) + clearChatLog); reset() also calls clearChatLog(current.id). ChatPanel.tsx: 会話をクリア button (enabled && log.length>0) wired to onClear with aria-label; App.tsx passes onClear={game.clearChat}. i18n.ts: added chat.clear / chat.clearAria in ja+en (additions only, no existing JA key changed). styles.css: lightweight .chat-header/.chat-clear rules (no new motion). Added 8 pure tests to game-ui.test.ts. VERIFIED: npm run build clean; frontend tests 112 -> 120 pass; shared 149 pass. Note: ui-helpers already had pet/zukan guarded helpers (the briefing's zukan path reference matches ZUKAN_STORAGE_KEY/readZukan*/parseZukan/writeZukan present in that file).
